verdict.rationale: Ardent documents a CI/CD workflow where every PR gets its own fresh database branch (ardent-docs-20). The pieces for CI automation are documented: `ardent branch create pr-123 --print-url`, JSON output and errors, token auth via ARDENT_TOKEN with no login step, idempotent re-runs, and an API aimed at CI systems and internal developer platforms. Teardown is only implied, through mentions of scripts and agents deleting their own branches. missing for 10: explicit documented branch-delete or automatic cleanup on PR close, native deploy-platform integrations (e.g. a Vercel or GitHub Actions integration), independent hands-on corroboration of the per-PR CI flow.
